title: SMAA breaks XR-enabled viewports
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.2-stable, 4.6.3-stable, 4.7.2 stable, and 4.8-dev5.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev5 - Bazzite 44.20260907.0 (Kinoite) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors (1920x1080 @ 59.96 Hz, 1600x900 @ 59.95 Hz) - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 610.57.04) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400F (12 threads) - 15.44 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Enabling SMAA on a Viewport node that has `Use XR` enabled will cause Godot to spam errors. This is not clear in the video, but the XR viewport also freezes on the HMD.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3de09291-8313-42ad-8dd6-159232c176a8

The errors are repeating the below messages:

> E 0:00:03:246   framebuffer_create: Layers of our texture doesn't match view count for this framebuffer
  <C++ Error>   Condition "texture && texture->layers != p_view_count" is true. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:3638 @ framebuffer_create()
E 0:00:03:246   _allocate_from_data: Condition "rid.is_null()" is true. Returning: rid
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/framebuffer_cache_rd.h:159 @ _allocate_from_data()
E 0:00:03:246   draw_list_begin: Parameter "framebuffer" is null.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5556 @ draw_list_begin()
E 0:00:03:246   framebuffer_get_format: Parameter "framebuffer" is null.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:3760 @ framebuffer_get_format()
E 0:00:03:246   framebuffer_format_get_texture_samples: Condition "!E" is true. Returning: TEXTURE_SAMPLES_1
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:3599 @ framebuffer_format_get_texture_samples()
E 0:00:03:246   render_pipeline_create: Mismatch fragment shader output mask (1) and framebuffer color output mask (0) when binding both in render pipeline.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "shader->fragment_output_mask != output_mask" is true. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4854 @ render_pipeline_create()
E 0:00:03:246   _generate_version: Condition "pipeline.is_null()" is true. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/pipeline_cache_rd.cpp:59 @ _generate_version()
E 0:00:03:246   draw_list_bind_render_pipeline: Condition "!draw_list.active" is true.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5692 @ draw_list_bind_render_pipeline()
E 0:00:03:246   draw_list_bind_uniform_set: Condition "!draw_list.active" is true.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5784 @ draw_list_bind_uniform_set()
E 0:00:03:246   draw_list_set_push_constant: Condition "!draw_list.active" is true.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5982 @ draw_list_set_push_constant()
E 0:00:03:246   draw_list_draw: Condition "!draw_list.active" is true.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5999 @ draw_list_draw()
E 0:00:03:246   draw_list_end: Immediate draw list is already inactive.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!draw_list.active" is true.
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6350 @ draw_list_end()

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make a project with a Viewport that has `Use XR` enabled
2. Change the `Screen Space AA` of this Viewport to SMAA

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Click the trigger on either XR controller to see the bug
[smaa-xr-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32142854/smaa-xr-bug.zip)
